title: Fernleigh Lodge
specs: Located on Kashwakamak Lake with access to Bon Echo Provincial Park
Known for home cooked meals and friendly service
Boat launch and slips provided at no additional fee
Bring your own linens, towels and toiletries or pay $15/person/week for linens

includes: Full kitchen with coffee maker, full sized refrigerator, stove with oven, pots, pans, dishes and silverware
Boat slip near your cottage and electricity to charge batteries
blurb: Guests stay in cozy cabins with full kitchens, bathrooms, and screened porches or decks. They can cook their own meals or opt for home-cooked meals in the dining room. Boat rentals and slips are available, and the resort is near Bon Echo Provincial Park with various outdoor activities.
extraNote: 25% of reservation due on booking, 25% due by February 1, final balance due on arrival · Cancellation refund: 60% if 4 months prior, 40% if 3 months prior, 20% if 2 months prior, no refund if 1 month prior · Cancellations must be made via telephone, not email · Pet fee $150 plus $250 damage deposit if damage occurs
